subject: Polish CLI hardening: real Windows-fallback test coverage (C1) + broaden protectedNames (C2)
description:
Follow-up to the approved attempt orch/attempt/3d98f672-2b47-4ef5-8282-f4db45cf1808-1 (commit 049688a). Address the judge's two non-blocking concerns, stacked ON TOP of that approved fix. Touches packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js + test/cli-init.test.js.

BRANCH SETUP (deterministic — do this exactly):
- branch_task with base=main (standard), then BEFORE editing, in the worktree run `git merge --no-edit orch/attempt/3d98f672-2b47-4ef5-8282-f4db45cf1808-1` to fast-forward in the approved fix (the new branch == main is an ancestor of that attempt, so it FFs to 049688a). Confirm `node test/cli-init.test.js` is 27/27 green BEFORE making changes. Now your branch contains the full prior fix; your diff vs main will show original + C1 + C2, and a later merge to main brings everything.

C1 — REAL fallback coverage (the meaningful one): the current skills test re-implements the symlink→junction→cpSync chain INLINE, so on a symlink-capable host the junction/cpSync branches (the Windows paths this whole fix exists for) get ZERO coverage. Fix by EXTRACTING the link strategy from checkSkills() into a testable pure helper, e.g. `linkSkill(src, dest, symlinkFn = fs.symlinkSync, cpFn = fs.cpSync)` that tries symlinkFn(src,dest) → symlinkFn(src,dest,'junction') → cpFn(src,dest,{recursive:true}) and returns which strategy succeeded (e.g. 'symlink'|'junction'|'copy'|null). Refactor checkSkills() to call it (no behavior change). Export it. Then add tests that INJECT a throwing symlinkFn to prove: (a) when symlink throws but junction works → 'junction'; (b) when both symlink+junction throw → cpFn is called and dest ends up a real dir with skill.md ('copy'); (c) the happy path still returns 'symlink'. Use a stub symlinkFn/cpFn (e.g. throwing functions + a cpFn that does fs.cpSync) so the fallback branches actually execute on this host.

C2 — broaden auto-heal protectedNames: in checkInstallDir()'s auto-heal copy loop, the protectedNames set omits runtime-state files the daemon writes to BASE — add at least `agents.json`, `loops.json`, `op-cache.json`, and `certs` (keep the existing overlay/sessions/worktrees/workspace/token/node_modules). Verify against what the daemon actually writes (grep daemon.js + lib for files written under BASE/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA). Keep it a minimal denylist broadening; do NOT rewrite to an allowlist unless trivial.

VERIFY: `node test/cli-init.test.js` must pass (all prior + new C1 tests), and the new C1 tests must actually exercise the junction+copy branches (confirm by reasoning/coverage, not just green). Keep scope to these two files. Commit all changes onto the attempt branch before complete_task. Do NOT merge to main — a judge reviews, then the dispatcher merges.

summary: C1+C2 addressed on branch orch/attempt/3d98f672-2b47-4ef5-8282-f4db45cf1808-3 (commit a66294e), based on approved fix 049688a (fast-forwarded in). C1: extracted linkSkill(src,dest,symlinkFn,cpFn) from checkSkills() — same symlink→junction→copy strategy but with injectable stubs; exported it; replaced the inline-chain test with 3 stub-injected tests that actually execute junction+copy branches on this host. C2: broadened protectedNames in checkInstallDir() to include agents.json, loops.json, loop.json, op-cache.json, tool-analytics.json, certs/, models/, tasks/, embed.pid, rerank.pid, rerank-server.log (all daemon runtime-state entries confirmed by grepping daemon.js + lib/*). 33/33 tests pass (28 prior + 5 new). Only packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js and test/cli-init.test.js were modified.

item.value: JUDGE VERDICT (self-learn-judge single-attempt, FLAT): APPROVE — hold-merge, awaiting dispatcher merge to main.
item.why: C1+C2 polish is correct, non-vacuously tested, and regresses none of the 5 original invariants. Tests: node test/cli-init.test.js → exit 0, 33/33 green.

winner_notes: C1: checkSkills() delegates to extracted exported linkSkill(src,dest,symlinkFn=fs.symlinkSync,cpFn=fs.cpSync) — symlink→junction→copy, returns winning strategy, null on total failure (warn path).

C1 tests NON-VACUOUS (proven): injected stubSymlink throws on 2-arg call → forces junction branch (test a); throws on both → forces copy branch with real dir + skill.md assertion (test b). Reran an intentionally-broken linkSkill (fallbacks stripped) and all 3 C1 assertions FAILED, confirming they catch a broken fallback. Fixes prior host-only-symlink coverage illusion.

C2: protectedNames broadened to agents.json, loops.json, loop.json, op-cache.json, tool-analytics.json, certs, models, tasks, embed.pid, rerank.pid, rerank-server.log. Verified EVERY one is listed in repo .gitignore as runtime state and NONE are git-tracked source — protecting them cannot skip a needed source copy.

No regression: no executable rm -rf (replaced by fs.rmSync); dirHasLiveData guard intact; resolveInstallDir intact; bin/install.js delegation (checkClaudeWiring spawnSync) intact; module.exports adds 3 new exports without dropping any.
Scope clean: only packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js + test/cli-init.test.js changed.
concerns: Cosmetic only: comment block mentions *.sock and *.pid globs but protectedNames Set uses explicit literals (embed.pid/rerank.pid/rerank-server.log). A Set can't glob anyway; leftover .sock files from the clone are harmlessly copied and live root .sock/.pid are untouched by the per-entry refresh. Not a defect.
